title: Ir-catalyzed reductive amination and transfer hydrogenation of diketones: access to β- and γ-amino alcohols
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38105-38109
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07386J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jinghui Tong, Shilin Guo, Huajie Zhu, Lu Ouyang, Jianhua Liao, Youchun Li
A mild protocol for the construction of β-and γ-amino alcohols via an iridium-catalyzes reductive amination and transfer hydrogenation of diketones with aromatic amines is described.
